C1094.title: Cross-Border E-Commerce Firms Used 7,000 Accounts to Defraud Massive Ad Traffic Fees
C1094.summary: Two cross-border e-commerce companies controlled over 7,000 advertising accounts and exploited payment settlement delays to defraud ad traffic fees totaling more than 70 million yuan on overseas social media platforms, constituting a malicious scheme to fraudulently obtain advertising payments.
